title: workitem-record
description: Cell-shape of a workitem — the in-flight data the dispatch chain passes between layers. Required cells are kind (∈ {process, procedure, derivation, inquiry}), skill (slug naming the capability the receiver must advertise), target (cell-id the response writes to). Kind-specific cells: parameters for process/procedure, prompt and optional maxTokens for derivation/inquiry. Per the workitem-record spec, the in-flight form coincides with the persisted-to-disk form. The dispatch chain's contract composer $refs this schema as the input shape of every dispatching-* skill.

skill.description: Kebab-case slug of the capability the receiver must advertise.

target.description: Cell-id naming where the response is written. The literal '<inline>' means return to caller, do not persist.

parameters.description: Argument object passed to the receiver script's default-exported function. Required when kind is process or procedure.

prompt.description: Textual prompt sent to the LLM the picker selects. Required when kind is derivation or inquiry.

maxTokens.description: Optional cap on response length. Adapter default applies when omitted.

prefer-receiver.description: Advisory receiver slug or path. Picker respects only when the named receiver advertises the capability.
